## 1. Refund Policy

### 1.1 30-Day Money-Back Guarantee

**What's for Dinner?** offers a **30-day money-back guarantee** on all subscription plans.

**Eligibility**:
- ✅ Refunds available within 30 days of purchase
- ✅ Applies to monthly and annual subscriptions
- ✅ No questions asked (but feedback appreciated)

**Refund Process**:
1. **Request**: Email support@whats-for-dinner.ca or cancel in-app
2. **Processing**: Refunds processed within 5-7 business days
3. **Confirmation**: Email confirmation sent when refund is processed

**Refund Method**:
- Refunds issued to original payment method (credit card, debit card)
- Processing time: 5-7 business days (may vary by payment provider)

### 1.2 Partial Refunds

**Pro-Rated Refunds** (for annual subscriptions):
- If you cancel an annual subscription after 30 days but within the year, you may be eligible for a pro-rated refund
- Contact support@whats-for-dinner.ca for details

**Non-Refundable**:
- ❌ Refunds not available after 30 days (except in exceptional circumstances)
- ❌ Refunds not available for promotional or discounted subscriptions (unless stated otherwise)

## 2. Cancellation Policy

### 2.1 How to Cancel

**Option 1: In-App Cancellation**
1. Open **What's for Dinner?** app
2. Go to **Settings** → **Subscription**
3. Tap **Cancel Subscription**
4. Confirm cancellation

**Option 2: Email Cancellation**
1. Email support@whats-for-dinner.ca
2. Include your account email address
3. Request cancellation

**Option 3: Stripe Portal** (if applicable)
1. Access Stripe customer portal
2. Cancel subscription

### 2.2 Cancellation Effect

**Access Continues**:
- ✅ Your subscription remains active until the end of the billing period
- ✅ You'll continue to have access to all features until [end date]
- ✅ No immediate cancellation (you've paid for the period)

**After Cancellation**:
- ✅ Account downgrades to Free plan (if applicable)
- ✅ Data retained (meal plans, preferences) for 2 years
- ✅ You can resubscribe anytime

### 2.3 Cancellation Confirmation

**Confirmation Email**:
- ✅ Email sent confirming cancellation
- ✅ End date of subscription provided
- ✅ Reminder 7 days before subscription ends

---

## 3. Subscription Changes

### 3.1 Upgrading

**Upgrade Process**:
- ✅ Upgrade anytime in-app (Settings → Subscription)
- ✅ Prorated billing (you pay difference for remaining period)
- ✅ Immediate access to upgraded features

**Example**:
- Current: Starter (CAD $9.99/month), 15 days remaining
- Upgrade: Pro (CAD $19.99/month)
- Charge: Prorated difference for 15 days

### 3.2 Downgrading

**Downgrade Process**:
- ✅ Downgrade anytime in-app (Settings → Subscription)
- ✅ Takes effect at end of current billing period
- ✅ No refund for unused portion (unless within 30-day guarantee)

**Example**:
- Current: Pro (CAD $19.99/month)
- Downgrade: Starter (CAD $9.99/month)
- Effect: Downgrades at end of billing period

---

## 4. Special Circumstances

### 4.1 Technical Issues

**If app is unusable due to technical issues**:
- ✅ Full refund available (even outside 30-day window)
- ✅ Contact support@whats-for-dinner.ca
- ✅ We'll investigate and resolve issue

### 4.2 Duplicate Charges

**If you're charged twice**:
- ✅ Contact support@whats-for-dinner.ca immediately
- ✅ We'll investigate and refund duplicate charge
- ✅ No time limit (always refunded)

### 4.3 Fraudulent Charges

**If you suspect fraudulent charges**:
- ✅ Contact support@whats-for-dinner.ca immediately
- ✅ We'll investigate and refund if confirmed
- ✅ Report to your bank/payment provider

---

## 5. Refund Exceptions

### 5.1 Non-Refundable Items

**The following are non-refundable**:
- ❌ Refunds after 30-day window (except exceptional circumstances)
- ❌ Refunds for promotional/discounted subscriptions (unless stated otherwise)
- ❌ Refunds for accounts terminated for Terms of Service violations

### 5.2 Exceptional Circumstances

**We may provide refunds outside the 30-day window for**:
- ✅ Technical issues making app unusable
- ✅ Duplicate charges
- ✅ Fraudulent charges
- ✅ Other exceptional circumstances (at our discretion)

**Contact**: support@whats-for-dinner.ca

## 6. GST/HST Refunds

### 6.1 Tax Refunds

**GST/HST Refunds**:
- ✅ Refunds include GST/HST (13% Ontario)
- ✅ Tax refunded automatically with subscription refund
- ✅ No separate tax refund process

**Example**:
- Subscription: CAD $9.99/month (includes GST/HST)
- Refund: CAD $9.99 (includes GST/HST)
